content.text:
I'm going with the **מניות** track at Harel (fund number 8522). I'm fairly sure, not totally. What decided it was the return: "24.04%" over 3 years and "14.64%" over 5. The S&P 500 one I came looking for shows "13.7%" and "11.92%". The fees are basically the same on both (0.55% vs 0.56%), so the higher number won.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** big heading "הראל". The "קופת גמל להשקעה 16" button was already lit up, so I didn't have to touch anything. Under it was a table.
- **Scrolling the table:** I looked for anything that said S&P and found "עוקב מדד S&P 500" with 13.7%. A few rows above it was "מניות" with 24.04%, which is way bigger. Most other rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" and have no return, so I ignored them.
- **The other two with numbers:**
  - "כללי" shows 13.5%.
  - "כספי (שקלי)" shows only 4.25%, which isn't the point of investing.
- **Fees:** every row is 0.54%–0.58% "מהחיסכון" and "0% מההפקדות". They all look the same, so fees didn't decide anything.
- **Money in the fund:** מניות has 7.3 billion and S&P has 2.3 billion. Both are big, so that felt safe.
- **What I skipped:**
  - the grey lines under the table
  - the "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" folds
  - the search box at the bottom
  - the top lines about "123 מקור"

**Words I didn't get:**
- "סחיר" (it's on half the tracks)
- "מט"ח" next to a yellow dot, with numbers like 99% and 25%
- the colored rings (I'm guessing they show how much is in shares)
- "התקרה בחוק: 1.05%"
- the "PF-10" tag

**What bothered me:**
- **Too many rows look the same:** 16 tracks, nearly the same fee, and most have no return number. I almost closed the page there. The only thing that helped me pick was the few rows that did show returns.
- **Missing rows:** the count says 16, but I'm not sure I saw them all. The bottom of the table cut off between screens.
- **What 24.04% means:** the header says "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת", so I read it as 24% every year. I'm not completely sure that's right.
- **מניות vs S&P:** my friends say S&P, and here "מניות" beats it. I don't know what's actually in "מניות", and nothing told me which one the page recommends.
